omnigate
========

A self-hostable AI gateway: a Zig data plane (omnigate-dp, the public proxy)
and an Elixir control plane (keys, budgets, usage, media jobs, dashboard).

Documentation, source and releases:

    https://github.com/Legatia/omnigate

    docs/quickstart.md      run it for the first time
    docs/deployment.md      containers, TLS, what to expose
    docs/configuration.md   every setting
    docs/upgrading.md       before replacing an older version
